admission.justification: Exact native generations, response-preserving fallback, revision/ETag-qualified browser reuse, independent document rendering and bounded retention jointly prevent stale content, repeated unchanged work and history growth. A cache hit, fast page or bounded map establishes none of the whole guarantee. Timing samples and code-review outcomes remain separately owned evidence.

guarantee: Native change-set computation remains authoritative while reusable results are retained only under complete stable input generations. Qualified body revisions and conditional ETags let bounded dashboard-owned content survive navigation without reparsing or retransmitting unchanged bodies; unchanged working viewer content retains its editor. Every introduced content/pending owner has named retention or cancellation limits. Missing, changing or unreadable generation evidence falls back to native reads without retention, with one admitted exception: a refusal may be retained on the named unknown-status stamp, never a successful result. An exact-id-keyed change-set result is served from its key with no observation; that accepted gap is named and is not a claim about unreadable generations. Current refusals stay visible, and counter latency/failure never gates the document. Cold reads, actual mutations, eviction, oversized content and changed editor content are outside unchanged-reuse promises.
